items.name: 1G SFP LR Transceiver Module, 1000BASE-LX/LH, 1310nm, 10km, Duplex LC, DDM
items.description: A high-performance, cost-effective Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) transceiver module designed for Gigabit Ethernet and Fiber Channel applications. This hot-swappable module supports data transfer rates of 1.25 Gbps (1000BASE-LX/LH) over single-mode fiber (SMF) with a reach of up to 10 kilometers. It operates at a nominal wavelength of 1310nm and features a Duplex LC connector. Equipped with Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) functions, it allows for real-time monitoring of critical parameters such as transmit and receive power, temperature, and voltage. The module is compliant with the SFP Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) and IEEE 802.3z standards, ensuring broad compatibility with various networking equipment. It operates on a single 3.3V power supply and is suitable for commercial temperature environments (0°C to 70°C). This transceiver is an ideal solution for extending network connections in data centers, enterprise networks, and metropolitan area networks, offering reliability and flexibility.

items.name: ATGBICS SFP-1G-LR-D Cisco® Compatible 1000Base BX-U SFP Transceiver Module
items.category: Fiber Optic Transceivers, SFP Modules, Network Components
items.description: The ATGBICS SFP-1G-LR-D is a high-performance, cost-effective SFP (Small Form-Factor Pluggable) transceiver module designed for Gigabit Ethernet applications. This hot-pluggable module supports a dual data-rate of 1.25Gbps/1.0625Gbps and is optimized for long-reach transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF) up to 10 kilometers. It utilizes a BX-U standard with a Tx wavelength of 1490nm and an Rx wavelength of 1310nm, connecting via an LC Simplex connector. The SFP-1G-LR-D features Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) support, enabling real-time monitoring of critical parameters such as device temperature, Tx and Rx optical power levels, and transceiver supply voltage. It is compliant with SFP Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) and SFF-8472 specifications, ensuring interoperability with a wide range of networking equipment. Built with a robust metal housing, it offers low EMI and operates reliably within a commercial temperature range of 0 to 70°C. This module provides a flexible and scalable solution for extending network connectivity in enterprise LANs, data centers, and other optical transmission systems requiring reliable Gigabit Ethernet links.
items.overview: The ATGBICS SFP-1G-LR-D is a versatile and reliable SFP transceiver designed to meet the demands of modern Gigabit Ethernet networks. This hot-pluggable module facilitates seamless integration into existing SFP ports, ensuring minimal downtime during installation or upgrades. It supports high-speed data transmission up to 1.25 Gbps over single-mode fiber, extending network reach up to 10 kilometers. Featuring a 1490nm transmitting wavelength and a 1310nm receiving wavelength, it utilizes an LC Simplex connector, making it ideal for Bi-Directional (BX) applications over a single fiber strand. The module is fully compliant with industry standards such as SFP MSA and SFF-8472, guaranteeing broad compatibility with network equipment from various manufacturers, including Cisco. Advanced Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) functionality allows network administrators to monitor key operational parameters in real-time, providing crucial insights for network maintenance and troubleshooting. Its robust construction and commercial operating temperature range ensure stable performance in diverse environments.

items.name: Cisco 1000BASE-LX/LH SFP Transceiver Module, 1310nm, 10km, Dual LC, Industrial Grade
items.description: The Cisco GLC-LX-SM-RGD is a robust 1G SFP (Small Form-Factor Pluggable) transceiver module engineered for reliable long-range data transmission in demanding industrial environments. It utilizes a 1310 nm wavelength interface and connects via a dual LC connector. This module supports Gigabit Ethernet communications and adheres to a compact SFP form factor as defined by industry standards. Designed for deployment with single-mode fiber (SMF), it can achieve link distances of up to 10 kilometers (6.2 miles). When used with legacy multimode fiber (MMF), it supports distances up to 550 meters, requiring a mode conditioning patch cable for optimal performance. The GLC-LX-SM-RGD is hot-pluggable, ensuring seamless upgrades and replacements with minimal network disruption. It is fully compliant with IEEE 802.3z 1000BASE-LX standards and Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) specifications, guaranteeing broad compatibility with Cisco switches, routers, and other MSA-compliant networking equipment. This ruggedized SFP features Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM/DOM) capabilities for real-time monitoring of operational parameters and is designed to operate across a wide industrial temperature range of -40°C to 85°C, making it suitable for harsh outdoor or industrial network deployments. Its low power consumption further contributes to a prolonged service life and energy efficiency.

items.name: Cisco 10/25GBASE-CSR SFP28 Dual-Rate Module for MMF
items.description: The Cisco SFP-10/25G-CSR-S is a high-density, low-power SFP28 (Small Form-Factor Pluggable 28) transceiver module designed for 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) and 25 Gigabit Ethernet (25GbE) connectivity options. It provides dual-rate capability, supporting data rates up to 25.78 Gbps, making it ideal for data center, high-performance computing, and enterprise network applications requiring flexible upgrade paths. The module operates over Multi-Mode Fiber (MMF) with an 850nm wavelength, utilizing a duplex LC/PC connector. It supports link lengths of up to 400 meters over OM4 fiber and 300 meters over OM3 fiber at both 10G and 25G (with RS-FEC on the host port for full 25G reach). This module is hot-pluggable and features Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) support for real-time monitoring of operating parameters. It is compliant with IEEE 802.3by, IEEE 802.3cc, and SFF-8402 standards. The SFP-10/25G-CSR-S is known for its reliable performance, quality, and energy efficiency, allowing for seamless integration and simplified network upgrades. It's often used in Internet Service Provider (ISP) access and metro networks, data center core networks, and enterprise campus networks.

items.description: The Cisco SFP-10/25G-LR-S is a high-performance 10/25GBASE-LR SFP28 optical transceiver module. Designed for data center, high-performance computing networks, and enterprise core and distribution layers, it offers high-density and low-power 25 Gigabit Ethernet and 10 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity options. This hot-pluggable SFP28 module operates over standard Single-Mode Fiber (SMF) G.652 with a 1310nm wavelength, supporting link lengths up to 10 kilometers. Its dual-rate capability allows for seamless upgrades from 10G to 25G without requiring hardware replacement. The module requires RS-FEC (Reed-Solomon Forward Error Correction) on the host ports for optimal 25G operation. It features a dual LC/PC connector and is fully compliant with SFP28 MSA, SFF-8472, SFF-8402, SFF-8432, SFF-8431, and applicable portions of IEEE 802.3by and IEEE 802.3cc standards. Built-in Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) functions enable easy installation, monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting. The module is certified and rigorously tested on Cisco SFP28 ports, ensuring superior performance, quality, and reliability.

items.name: Cisco 10GBASE-SR SFP+ Transceiver Module
items.description: The 10GBASE-SR SFP+ transceiver module is a high-performance, cost-effective, and hot-swappable input/output device designed for 10 Gigabit Ethernet links over multimode fiber. It supports data rates of 10 Gbps (10.31 Gbps) and operates at an 850 nm wavelength. This module offers flexible connectivity options, achieving link lengths of up to 26 meters on standard FDDI-grade multimode fiber (MMF), up to 300 meters over OM3 MMF, and an impressive 400 meters over OM4 MMF. It features a duplex LC connector for reliable fiber optic connections. Designed for seamless interoperability in multi-vendor environments, it complies with industry standards such as IEEE 802.3ae, SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and SFF-8472. The module incorporates Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) or Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM) capabilities, allowing real-time monitoring of operating parameters like temperature, optical input/output power, and supply voltage, which aids in network troubleshooting and maintenance. Its low power consumption (typically less than 1W) contributes to energy efficiency and reduced heat generation, extending the lifespan of networking equipment. The transceiver utilizes a high-quality VCSEL laser transmitter and a PIN Photodiode receiver for optimal optical performance. It is ideal for a wide range of applications including data centers, enterprise wiring closets, service provider transport, and campus networks.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 2950-24 Intelligent Ethernet Switch, 24-Port 10/100 Fast Ethernet (Standard Image)
items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 2950 Series Intelligent Ethernet Switches provide an affordable and scalable solution for small to mid-sized networks and enterprise branch offices. The WS-C2950-24 model is a standalone, fixed-configuration, managed Layer 2 switch featuring 24 10/100 Mbps Fast Ethernet ports, offering wire-speed performance for connecting end-stations and users to the LAN. While this specific model operates with the Standard Image (SI) software, supporting basic Cisco IOS Software functions, other models in the 2950 series may offer Enhanced Image (EI) software for advanced intelligent services and Gigabit Ethernet uplink capabilities. 

Key features include advanced security protocols such as Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP), Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP), IGMP snooping for multicast filtering, port security, and MAC address filtering. It also supports Virtual LAN (VLAN) technology with IEEE 802.1Q tagging, allowing network administrators to segment networks for enhanced security, improved performance, and simplified management. Quality of Service (QoS) features are present with 4 egress queues per port, enabling prioritization of critical traffic like voice or video.

Management is simplified through a command-line interface (CLI), a user-friendly Web management interface (Cisco Device Manager), and compatibility with SNMP and CiscoWorks management platforms. The switch is designed for rack-mounting, typically in a 1U form factor, offering flexibility in deployment. Although the Catalyst 2950 series reached its End-of-Life (EOL) on October 20, 2013, it remains a cost-effective option for legacy network infrastructure, often available as refurbished units.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 2960-CX 8-Port PoE+ Compact Switch, LAN Base
items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 2960-CX 8-Port PoE+ Compact Switch (WS-C2960CX-8PC-L) is a high-performance, managed Gigabit Ethernet switch designed for optimized network deployments in space-constrained environments. It features 8 Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ ports, capable of delivering up to 30W per port with a total PoE budget of 124W, making it ideal for powering IP phones, wireless access points, IP cameras, and other PoE-enabled devices without additional power cabling. The switch also includes 2 x 1 Gigabit copper and 2 x 1 Gigabit SFP uplinks for flexible network connectivity and expansion. [1, 2, 7]

Part of the Cisco Catalyst 2960-CX Series, this switch operates with a fanless design, ensuring silent operation, which is crucial for deployments in offices, classrooms, hotels, and retail stores. Its compact form factor allows for versatile mounting options, including wall-mounting or under desks, facilitating shorter cable runs and simplified network infrastructure. [3, 5, 8]

Key features include advanced Layer 2 switching capabilities, such as VLAN support (up to 255 active VLANs, 4K VLAN IDs) and Quality of Service (QoS) for efficient data traffic management. It comes with the LAN Base feature set, providing intelligent Layer 2 through 4 services. The switch supports various IEEE standards including 802.1D, 802.1p, 802.1Q, 802.1x, 802.3af, and 802.3at (PoE+). It also incorporates Cisco Network Plug-n-Play (PnP) for automated installation and configuration, enhancing productivity and reducing operational costs. [1, 3, 5, 7, 10]

With a robust switching bandwidth of 24 Gbps (full-duplex capacity) and a forwarding bandwidth of 12 Gbps, coupled with a forwarding rate of 17.9 Mpps, the WS-C2960CX-8PC-L ensures smooth and efficient data handling in demanding environments. It boasts a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of over 569,000 hours, emphasizing its reliability and long-term performance stability. Comprehensive management options, including SNMP, RMON, and web-based management, provide network administrators with easy monitoring and configuration. [1, 4, 5]

items.description: The Cisco Catalyst 3560-CX Series Compact Switches are designed to extend enterprise-grade Gigabit Ethernet and Multigigabit Ethernet infrastructure outside the wiring closet. These fanless, small form-factor switches are ideal for space-constrained deployments in diverse environments such as offices, classrooms, hotels, and retail stores, where multiple cable runs would be challenging. The 3560-CX series optimizes network deployments by providing high-speed data connectivity, Wi-Fi backhaul, and Power over Ethernet Plus (PoE+) connectivity. With a single copper or fiber cable from the wiring closet, these compact switches enable IP connectivity for a wide range of devices including IP phones, wireless access points, surveillance cameras, PCs, and video endpoints. Key features include support for multiple speeds (100 Mbps, 1 Gbps, 2.5 Gbps, 5 Gbps, and 10 Gbps over Cat 5e/Cat 6a cabling), PoE/PoE+ support with up to 240W budget, and advanced Layer 2 (LAN Base) and Layer 3 (IP Base, upgradable to IP Services) features. They offer management simplicity through Cisco Network Assistant, CLI, and SNMP, alongside robust security features like Cisco TrustSec, MACsec, DHCP snooping, and IP Source Guard. Energy-efficient technologies such as Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) and switch hibernation mode contribute to reduced power consumption. Some models also support Perpetual PoE, ensuring uninterrupted power to connected devices even during switch reboots, and PoE pass-through for powering end devices by drawing Cisco UPOE from an upstream switch.

items.description: The Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series is a next-generation, enterprise-class, standalone and stackable access-layer switch that provides the foundation for full convergence between wired and wireless networks on a single platform. Built on the advanced Cisco StackWise-160 technology and leveraging the new Cisco Unified Access Data Plane (UADP) application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC), this series enables uniform wired-wireless policy enforcement, application visibility, flexibility, application optimization, and superior resiliency. The 3650 Series switches support full IEEE 802.3at Power over Ethernet Plus (PoE+) and, on some multigigabit models, Cisco Universal Power over Ethernet (Cisco UPOE®). They offer modular and field-replaceable redundant fans and power supplies. The switches come in a 12-inch lower depth form factor, making them suitable for deployment in tight wiring closets in remote branches and offices. Additionally, the 3650 multigigabit switches support current and next-generation wireless speeds and standards, including 802.11ac Wave 2, on existing cabling infrastructure, helping to increase wireless productivity and reduce total cost of ownership (TCO). Each 48-port model provides 40 Gbps of wireless throughput, and each 24-port model provides 20 Gbps, with capacity increasing with more stack members. This particular model, the WS-C3650-48PS-L, offers 48 x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports with PoE+ capabilities, providing up to 390W of PoE power with up to 30W per port, and includes 4 x 1G SFP uplink interfaces, operating with a LAN Base feature set.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 9200 48-port PoE+ Switch, Network Essentials
items.description: The Cisco Catalyst C9200-48P-E is a high-availability, modular access switch designed for enterprise campus and branch environments. It extends the power of intent-based networking and Catalyst 9000 hardware and software innovation to a broader set of deployments, offering simplicity without compromise – it is secure, always on, and IT simplified. This model provides 48 full Power over Ethernet Plus (PoE+) ports capable of delivering up to 740W with a single power supply, and up to 1440W with dual power supplies, for powering IP phones, wireless access points, and IoT devices via IEEE 802.3at. It features flexible modular uplink options, supporting various network modules such as 4x 1GE or 4x 10GE. Resiliency is ensured with Field-Replaceable Units (FRU), redundant power supply support, and redundant fans. Operational efficiency is enhanced with optional backplane stacking, supporting stacking bandwidth up to 160 Gbps. The switch utilizes the UADP 2.0 Mini with an integrated CPU for optimized scale and better cost structure. Enhanced security features include AES-128 MACsec encryption, policy-based segmentation, and trustworthy systems. It offers Layer 3 capabilities, including OSPF, EIGRP, ISIS, RIP, and routed access, along with advanced network monitoring using Full Flexible NetFlow. The C9200-48P-E also supports Cisco Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) for simplified operations and deployment with policy-based automation and network assurance through Cisco DNA Center™. Plug and Play (PnP) is enabled for easy device rollouts and updates.

items.description: The Cisco Catalyst C9200CX-12P-2X2G-E is a high-performance, compact, and fanless PoE+ access switch specifically engineered for deployments where space and noise are constrained. Its compact form factor allows for flexible deployment options, including rack-mounting, wall-mounting, or under-table installation.

items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 9300-24T-E is a high-performance 24-port Gigabit Ethernet switch, part of Cisco's leading stackable enterprise switching platform. Designed for security, IoT, mobility, and cloud, this data-only switch (without Power over Ethernet capabilities) delivers secure, scalable, and resilient networking for modern campus and enterprise environments. It features 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports for data connectivity and includes a modular uplink slot for flexible network expansion, supporting options such as 1G, 10G, and 40G SFP modules.

Powered by an x86 CPU complex with 8 GB DRAM and 16 GB flash, the C9300-24T-E runs Cisco IOS XE software, enabling advanced programmability features like NETCONF, Python scripting, RESTCONF, YANG models, and streaming telemetry. It integrates seamlessly with Cisco DNA Center or Meraki Dashboard for centralized management, simplifying operations and automating policy management via Cisco's intent-based networking approach.

The switch boasts a switching capacity of 208 Gbps full-duplex, expandable up to 688 Gbps with StackWise-480 technology, providing up to 480 Gbps of bidirectional stacking bandwidth for up to 8 switches. Its forwarding performance is 154.76 Mpps, reaching up to 511.90 Mpps in a stack. Key security features include line-rate AES-256 MACsec, Secure Boot with Trust Anchor Module, 802.1X, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, IP Source Guard, and scalable ACLs. The C9300-24T-E is a rack-mountable 1U design, ideal for space-efficient deployment in small to medium-sized networks, enterprise campuses, and branch offices requiring high-speed, data-only access without PoE.

items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 9300-48T-A is a high-performance enterprise network switch from the industry's most widely deployed stackable switching platform, the Catalyst 9300 Series. Built for modern network demands, including security, IoT, and cloud applications, this switch forms the foundational building block for Cisco's Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) architecture.

Featuring a robust fixed-architecture design, the C9300-48T-A is equipped with 48 10/100/1000 Gigabit Ethernet ports, complemented by modular uplink connectivity for versatile data transmission. It is a data-only model, meaning it does not support Power over Ethernet (PoE). The switch supports advanced stacking capabilities with Cisco StackWise-480, delivering up to 480 Gbps of stacking bandwidth to bolster scalability and simplify network management.

Powered by the Cisco UADP 2.0 Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC), it offers a programmable pipeline and micro-engine capabilities, along with template-based, configurable allocation of Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Quality of Service (QoS) entries. The C9300-48T-A runs on Cisco IOS XE, a modern operating system for the enterprise that supports model-driven programmability, including NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG, on-box Python scripting, streaming telemetry, and container-based application hosting.

Key features include advanced security measures like Encrypted Traffic Analytics (ETA) for malware detection in encrypted traffic without decryption, support for AES-256 with MACsec 256-bit encryption, and hardware-anchored Secure Boot with Secure Unique Device Identification (SUDI) for trustworthy systems. It is optimized for Wi-Fi 6 and 802.11ac Wave 2 access points and offers energy-efficient operation with support for IEEE 802.3az, variable-speed fans, and optimized power supplies.

The Catalyst 9300-48T-A is ideal for campus edge deployments, branch offices, and enterprise environments, providing secure, scalable, and high-performance networking solutions for businesses transitioning to hybrid work models.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 9300 C9300-48UXM-A 48x Multigigabit UPOE RJ45 1x Module Slot Network Advantage Switch
items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series C9300-48UXM-A is a high-performance, enterprise-class stackable access switch designed to meet the evolving demands of modern networks, including security, IoT, mobility, and cloud. As a foundational building block for Cisco's Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) architecture, this switch offers robust capabilities for large-scale deployments and high-density environments. It features 48 multigigabit UPOE RJ45 ports, including 36 ports supporting 100 Mbps, 1G, or 2.5G, and 12 ports offering 100 Mbps, 1G, 2.5G, 5G, or 10G speeds, providing high-speed data transfer and reducing latency for a variety of devices, including high-performance access points and cameras.

Powered by an x86 CPU architecture and running on Cisco IOS XE with programmability, the C9300-48UXM-A is future-ready, capable of hosting containers and running third-party applications natively within the switch. It delivers a formidable switching capacity of 580 Gbps in standalone mode, expandable to 1060 Gbps with StackWise-480 technology, and a forwarding rate of 431.54 Mpps (788.69 Mpps stacked). The switch includes a 1100W AC power supply and supports a PoE budget of 490W, ensuring ample power for connected UPOE devices. Its modular uplink slot provides flexibility for expansion with various network modules, supporting 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, and 100G optics.

Key security features include TrustSec, hardware MACsec-128 encryption, and SD-Access, providing a secure and intelligent network fabric. The switch also supports advanced Layer 3 routing protocols such as OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and VRF-Lite, along with VXLAN for scalable network segmentation. With a MAC address table size of 32,000, 8 GB of DRAM, and 16 GB of Flash memory, the C9300-48UXM-A is built for comprehensive network management and high-volume traffic.

The Cisco Catalyst C9300X-12Y-A is a high-performance, high-density, data-only fiber access switch engineered for demanding enterprise-level networks, campus deployments, and data-center edge environments. It features 12 multi-rate SFP28 fiber ports, supporting speeds of 25 Gbps, 10 Gbps, or 1 Gbps, facilitating flexible connectivity and seamless migration to higher-speed optics as network demands evolve. It is optimized for high-density Wi-Fi 6 and 802.11ac Wave2 deployments. The C9300X-12Y-A integrates advanced security features such as MACsec encryption, advanced Access Control Lists (ACLs), secure boot, and Trustworthy Systems. Key performance metrics include a switching capacity of up to 1,000 Gbps (2,000 Gbps when stacked) and a forwarding rate of approximately 744.04 Mpps (1488 Mpps in stacking mode). items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst C9300X-24Y-E is a flagship model within Cisco's Catalyst 9300 Series, meticulously designed to address the rigorous demands of modern enterprise networks. As a next-generation stackable access switch, it delivers unparalleled performance, scalability, and security for campus and branch network infrastructures. Engineered for high-density 25 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity, this switch is optimized for environments requiring robust data throughput, advanced programmability, and seamless integration with Cisco's Digital Network Architecture (DNA). The '24Y' designation signifies 24 multi-rate SFP28 ports, supporting speeds of 25 Gbps, 10 Gbps, or 1 Gbps over fiber optic cabling, providing investment protection and enabling seamless migration as network bandwidth demands grow.

Built on Cisco's Unified Access Data Plane (UADP) 2.0Sec ASIC, the C9300X-24Y-E offers enhanced packet processing capabilities, hardware-based encryption including 100G IPsec, and support for advanced telemetry. It runs Cisco IOS XE Software, a modular operating system facilitating programmability, automation, and comprehensive security features. The 'E' suffix denotes the Enterprise licensing tier, unlocking advanced features such as full Layer 3 routing capabilities (including OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and multicast routing), enhanced security protocols, and extensive automation tools.

The switch chassis features four modular uplink slots, providing exceptional flexibility and future-proofing. These slots support various C9300X network modules, such as NM-8Y (8x 25G/10G/1G SFP), NM-2C (2x 100G/40G QSFP), or NM-4C (4x 100G/40G QSFP), allowing tailored aggregation or core connectivity without forklift upgrades. It supports StackWise-1T technology, enabling stacking of up to eight switches into a single logical unit with 1 Tbps of local stackable switching bandwidth, ensuring robust resiliency and high-speed fiber access at the network edge. With 16 GB of DRAM and 16 GB of flash memory, it supports advanced Layer 3 services directly on the switch, enabling low-latency, on-premise services. It also features dual redundant, hot-swappable power supplies and front-to-back redundant fans for optimized cooling and high availability.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 9300X-48HX-E 48-Port Multi-Gigabit UPoE+ RJ45 Network Essentials Switch
items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 9300X-48HX-E is a high-performance, enterprise-grade network switch designed for modern campus networks, large corporate campuses, branch offices, and distributed enterprise networks. It features 48 multi-gigabit (10G/5G/2.5G/1G/100M) UPoE+ RJ45 downlink ports, delivering up to 90W of power per port for power-hungry PoE devices like high-density wireless APs, VoIP phones, and IoT sensors. This switch comes with one expansion module slot for flexible uplink options, supporting modular 10/25/40/100 Gbps connectivity. 

Built on the Cisco UADP 2.0sec ASIC, the C9300X-48HX-E provides advanced security capabilities including AES-256 MACsec encryption and 100 Gbps hardware-based IPsec throughput for secure tunnel connectivity to Secure Internet Gateway, Cloud Service Providers, and site-to-site VPNs with zero performance penalty. It offers robust performance with a switching capacity of 2000 Gbps (expandable to 3000 Gbps in stacking mode) and a forwarding rate of 1488 Mpps (2232 Mpps in stacking mode). The MAC Address Table supports up to 32,000 entries, ensuring efficient communication across large networks. 

The switch supports 1 Tbps StackWise-1T stacking bandwidth for seamless, scalable high-availability clusters of up to eight switches, enabling non-stop fabric expansion. It also features StackPower+ for power resiliency. Enhanced application hosting is supported by an x86 CPU, 4GB DDR4 RAM, 4GB Flash storage, and a USB 3.0 SSD slot for containerized network services and real-time analytics. The C9300X-48HX-E is manageable via Cisco DNA Center, CLI, and SNMP, supporting simplified operations and network automation.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 9300X 48-Port MultiGigabit UPOE+ Network Advantage Switch
items.description:
The Cisco Catalyst 9300X 48-Port MultiGigabit UPOE+ Switch (C9300X-48HX-N) is Cisco's lead stackable enterprise switching platform, designed for the demands of security, IoT, mobility, and cloud environments. As part of the Catalyst 9300 Series, it serves as a foundational building block for Cisco's Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) architecture, offering simplified device deployment, unified management of wired and wireless networks, and network virtualization. 

This high-performance switch features 48 MultiGigabit Ethernet ports (10G/5G/2.5G/1G/100M) with UPOE+ capabilities, delivering up to 90W per port to support power-hungry PoE devices such as high-density wireless access points, VoIP phones, and IoT sensors. It boasts a robust x86 CPU complex with 16 GB of memory and 16 GB of flash storage, along with an external USB 3.0 SSD pluggable slot for up to 240GB of additional storage, enabling advanced application hosting and containerized services directly on the switch. 

The C9300X-48HX-N offers up to 1 Tbps of local stackable switching bandwidth with StackWise-1T technology, allowing for seamless, scalable high-availability clusters of up to eight switches. It provides a switching capacity of 1,760 Gbps (non-blocking) in standalone mode, expandable to 3,000 Gbps with stacking, and a forwarding rate of 1,309 Mpps, ensuring wire-speed performance and ultra-low latency. 

Advanced security features include 100 Gbps hardware IPsec throughput for encrypted site-to-site VPN tunnels and secure cloud connectivity, along with AES-256 MACsec link encryption on every port for industry-leading data-in-transit security. The modular uplink options support flexible offerings with 100G, 40G, 25G, Multigigabit, 10G, and 1G speeds, providing infrastructure investment protection and easy migration.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst 9300X Series 48-Port 10G Multi-Gigabit Ethernet Switch
items.description: The Cisco Catalyst 9300X Series switches are Cisco's flagship stackable enterprise access switching platform, designed to meet the demands of modern campus networks and branch-office deployments, supporting enhanced security, IoT integration, mobility, and cloud readiness. This model, the C9300X-48TX, features 48 x 10GBASE-T copper ports, which auto-negotiate down to 1 Gbps and 100 Mbps, providing wire-speed performance through a 1 Tbps StackWise-1T fabric (scalable to 2.76 Tbps in an eight-member stack). It is built on the Cisco UADP 2.0sec ASIC, offering line-rate support for Crypto, including 100G hardware-based IPsec and AES-256 MACsec encryption for secure site-to-site VPN and link-level data protection. The switch is powered by an x86 CPU complex with 16 GB of DRAM and 16 GB of flash memory, and includes an external USB 3.0 SSD pluggable storage slot (supporting up to 240GB with an optional SSD drive) to host containers and third-party applications directly on the switch for real-time analytics. It offers flexible and dense uplink options with modular slots supporting 100G, 40G, 25G, Multi-Gigabit, 10G, and 1G. Optimized for high-density Wi-Fi 6 and 802.11ac Wave 2 deployments, the Catalyst 9300X provides highest wireless scale. It supports Cisco's Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) architecture and includes features like Stateful Switchover (NSF/SSO) for high availability with sub-50-millisecond failover. The switch supports a robust power system with redundant PSU capabilities.

items.name: Cisco Catalyst C1300-16P-4X 16-Port Gigabit PoE+ Managed Network Switch
items.description: The Cisco Catalyst C1300-16P-4X is an enterprise-grade, managed Layer 3 Gigabit Ethernet switch designed for small to medium-sized businesses (SMBs) and branch offices. It combines simplicity, flexibility, and robust security, making it suitable for deployments beyond traditional wiring closets. This model features 16 x 10/100/1000 PoE+ ports with a 120W power budget, allowing for seamless connectivity and power delivery to devices like IP phones, security cameras, and wireless access points. Additionally, it is equipped with 4 x 10 Gigabit SFP+ uplink ports for high-speed data transfers and enhanced network performance. The switch operates on a customized Linux-based operating system, featuring an easy-to-use dashboard and mobile app for streamlined network configuration and advanced functionality. It supports front-panel stacking of up to 8 units within the same family, enabling unified management and simplified expansion. Key security features include IEEE 802.1X, port security, DHCP Snooping, DoS attack prevention, RADIUS authentication, IP-MAC port binding, and IPv6 First Hop Security. The fanless design ensures silent operation, making it ideal for noise-sensitive environments. With advanced Layer 3 traffic management capabilities like dynamic routing, inter-VLAN routing, and support for up to 4093 VLANs, the C1300-16P-4X helps businesses organize their networks more effectively and efficiently. It also supports IPv6, Energy Efficient Ethernet (IEEE 802.3az), and offers high reliability with dual images for minimal network downtime.

As part of the Catalyst 9200CX Series, it offers simplicity without compromise, ensuring secure, always-on, and IT-simplified operations. This versatile switch features 12 Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ RJ45 ports, providing power and connectivity to a variety of devices like IP phones, wireless access points, and IoT endpoints. For high-speed connections, it is equipped with 2x 1 Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 and 2x 10 Gigabit Ethernet SFP+ uplink ports.

Built on the Cisco Unified Access Data Plane 2.0 Mini (UADP) architecture with an integrated CPU, the C9200CX-12P-2X2G delivers optimized scale with a better cost structure and protects investments with flexible, programmable pipelines. It supports a switching capacity of 68 Gbps and a forwarding rate of 50.59 Mpps, ensuring fast data transmission and efficient packet processing. The fanless design enables silent operation, making it ideal for noise-constrained environments such as retail locations, kiosks, industrial control rooms, and small branches. Advanced security features include AES-256 MACsec encryption, policy-based segmentation, and trustworthy solutions for robust network protection. The switch also offers Layer 3 capabilities, including OSPF, EIGRP, ISIS, RIP, and routed access, along with advanced network monitoring using Full Flexible NetFlow. Available with Network Essentials or Network Advantage software subscriptions, it integrates seamlessly into the Cisco Digital Network Architecture (DNA), simplifying complexity, optimizing IT, and reducing operational costs through intelligence and automation.

items.name: Cisco Compatible 1000BASE-SX SFP Transceiver Module (MMF, 850nm, 550m, LC, Industrial)
items.category: SFP Transceiver Module, Fiber Optics, Networking
items.description:
The GLC-SX-MM-RGD is a Cisco-compatible SFP (Small Form-Factor Pluggable) transceiver module designed for robust 1000BASE-SX Gigabit Ethernet applications. This hot-pluggable module supports data rates of up to 1.25Gbps (Gigabit Ethernet) and 1.063Gbps (1x Fibre Channel) over multi-mode fiber (MMF). It operates at an 850nm wavelength and can achieve a maximum transfer distance of 550 meters (1800 feet) over 50/125µm MMF or 220 meters over 62.5/125µm MMF. 

Equipped with a Dual LC connector, the transceiver features a high-quality VCSEL laser transmitter and a PIN photodiode receiver. It supports Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM/DDM) for real-time diagnostics, providing valuable insights into operating conditions. A key feature of this module is its industrial operating temperature range, from -40°C to +85°C (-40°F to 185°F), making it suitable for deployment in harsh environments such as telecommunications, industrial automation, data processing, mining, and intelligent transportation systems. It adheres to industry standards including IEEE 802.3z 1000Base-SX, MSA (Multi-Source Agreement), and SFF-8472, ensuring seamless integration and compatibility with a wide range of Cisco networking equipment including switches, routers, and servers. The module is designed for low power consumption, typically less than 0.8W, and is RoHS compliant for environmental safety.

items.name: Cisco Compatible 10GBASE-ER SFP+ Transceiver Module (SMF, 1550nm, 40km, LC, DOM)
items.description:
The 10GBASE-ER SFP+ (Enhanced Small Form-Factor Pluggable Plus) transceiver module is designed for 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) deployments, offering extended reach over single-mode fiber. This hot-pluggable module supports data rates from 1.25 Gbps up to 11.3 Gbps, making it versatile for applications such as 10G Ethernet, Gigabit Ethernet, and STM-64. It is capable of transmitting data up to 40 kilometers (24.8 miles) over standard Single-Mode Fiber (SMF, G.652) using a 1550nm DFB (Distributed Feedback) laser transmitter and a PIN photodiode or APD receiver.

The module features a duplex LC connector interface and supports Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM) or Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) functions, which allow network administrators to monitor real-time parameters such as optical output power, optical input power, temperature, laser bias current, and transceiver supply voltage. This ensures strong diagnostic capabilities and easy troubleshooting. It operates within a commercial temperature range of 0°C to 70°C and has a low power dissipation, typically less than 1.5W.

Compliant with industry standards including IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-ER/EW, SFF-8431, SFF-8432, SFF-8472, and RoHS, this SFP+ module is built for reliability and interoperability. It is widely compatible with Cisco switches and routers (e.g., Firepower, ASR9000, ASR1000, NCS5500, C3850) and many other MSA (Multi-Source Agreement) compliant networking equipment from brands like Ubiquiti, D-Link, Netgear, Supermicro, and TP-Link. Ideal for data centers, enterprise wiring closets, and service provider transport applications, it offers a cost-effective solution for extending 10GbE optical links.

items.name: Cisco GLC-LH-SM 1000BASE-LX/LH SFP Transceiver Module
items.description: The Cisco GLC-LH-SM 1000BASE-LX/LH Ethernet transceiver is a Duplex SFP (Small Form-Factor Pluggable) module engineered for robust optical communications within Gigabit Ethernet applications. It operates at a nominal wavelength of 1310 nm, providing high-performance connectivity. This hot-swappable module ensures reliable data transmission over various fiber types, supporting distances up to 10 kilometers (6.2 miles) when utilizing standard single-mode fiber (SMF) and up to 550 meters (1,804 feet) over legacy multimode fiber (MMF). Connectivity is achieved via a dual LC/PC connector. The GLC-LH-SM fully complies with the IEEE 802.3z 1000BASE-LX/LH standard, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance within a wide range of Cisco switches and routers. A key characteristic of this particular module is the absence of Digital Optical Monitoring (DDM) capabilities, differentiating it from variants like the GLC-LH-SMD. It offers a robust and cost-effective solution for extending network reach in enterprise LAN, SAN, and service provider environments. The module is also RoHS compliant, adhering to environmental standards.

items.description: The Cisco GLC-SX-MM is a 1000BASE-SX Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) transceiver module designed for Gigabit Ethernet applications. This hot-swappable input/output device plugs into a Gigabit Ethernet port or slot, linking the port with the network. It operates over multi-mode fiber (MMF) at an 850nm wavelength. The module supports data transfer rates of up to 1.25 Gbps. It is compatible with the IEEE 802.3z 1000BASE-SX standard and can achieve distances of up to 550 meters over 50 µm multimode fiber and 220 meters over 62.5 µm Fiber Distributed Data Interface (FDDI)-grade multimode fibers. It can also support up to 1km over laser-optimized 50 µm multimode fiber cable. The GLC-SX-MM features a duplex LC connector and operates within a standard temperature range of 0° to 70°C. It utilizes a VCSEL laser transmitter and PIN photodiode receiver, and has a low power consumption of less than 1 Watt. This module is ideal for Internet Service Provider (ISP) Gigabit Ethernet communication links, Enterprise LAN & SAN Networks, Data Center LAN & SAN Networks, and other optical links, offering a reliable and cost-effective solution for high-speed data transmission.

items.name: Cisco GLC-T 1000BASE-T SFP Transceiver Module
items.description: The Cisco GLC-T is an industry-standard 1000BASE-T Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) Gigabit Interface Converter (GBIC) designed for copper networks. This hot-swappable input/output device plugs into Gigabit Ethernet ports or slots, linking the port with the network. It provides full-duplex Gigabit Ethernet connectivity for high-end workstations, wiring closets, and various network segments over existing copper infrastructure. The module operates on standard Category 5 unshielded twisted pair (UTP) copper cabling, or higher, of up to 100 meters (328 ft) link length. It supports 10/100/1000 Mbps auto-negotiation and Auto MDI/MDIX, ensuring seamless integration and flexible deployment. The GLC-T is compliant with IEEE 802.3ab 1000BASE-T standards and offers a robust design for enhanced reliability and simplified serviceability.

items.name: Cisco Nexus 3548-XL Network Switch
items.description: The Cisco Nexus 3548-XL Switch (N3K-C3548P-XL) is a high-performance, compact one-rack-unit (1RU) 10 Gigabit Ethernet switch designed for data center environments requiring ultra-low latency. It provides line-rate Layer 2 and 3 switching capabilities across all its 48 SFP+ ports, supporting both 1 Gigabit and 10 Gigabit Ethernet speeds. This switch runs the industry-leading Cisco NX-OS software operating system, offering a comprehensive set of features and functions widely deployed globally. A key architectural advantage of the Nexus 3548-XL is the absence of physical layer (PHY) chips, contributing to its ultra-low latency and reduced power consumption. The XL model specifically features a faster 2.5 GHz CPU, 16 GB of system memory, and 16 GB of bootflash memory, enabling support for the Cisco NX-OS Data Management Engine (DME) model. The Nexus 3548-XL is ideal for High-Frequency Trading (HFT), High-Performance Computing (HPC), and big data environments due to its exceptional performance, advanced visibility, automation features, and precise time synchronization capabilities.

items.description:
The Cisco Nexus 9300-FX3 Series N9K-C93180YC-FX3 is a high-performance, fixed-configuration data center switch, part of Cisco's Nexus 9000 Series. Built on Cisco Cloud Scale technology, this switch is designed to meet the demanding requirements of modern data centers and enterprise networks, offering exceptional performance, scalability, and flexibility. It features 48 SFP28 downlink ports supporting 1/10/25 Gigabit Ethernet speeds and 6 QSFP28 uplink ports supporting 40/100 Gigabit Ethernet.

This switch is optimized for cost-effective cloud-scale deployments, supporting an increased number of endpoints and delivering wire-rate security and telemetry. It provides lightning-fast data transfers and seamless network performance with a switching capacity of up to 3.6 Tbps and a forwarding rate of up to 1.2 Bpps. The N9K-C93180YC-FX3 is ideal for high-density data center aggregation and cloud environments, supporting advanced features like VXLAN and EVPN for network virtualization and segmentation.

Key features include built-in MACsec encryption on every port for robust Layer 2 security, ensuring secure data encryption for east-west and uplink traffic without sacrificing throughput or latency. It also incorporates Synchronous Ethernet (SyncE) and PTP boundary-clock capabilities (1PPS/10 MHz/ToD) for precise time synchronization, crucial for latency-sensitive applications like 5G UPF and financial trading networks. The switch operates in both Cisco NX-OS mode for standard Nexus environments and Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure) mode, providing flexibility for diverse network architectures and automation needs. With its advanced traffic management features, large shared buffers, and efficient airflow design, the N9K-C93180YC-FX3 ensures reliable operation even under intense workloads.

items.name: Cisco Nexus 93240YC-FX2 Switch, 48x 1/10/25G SFP+ and 12x 40/100G QSFP28 Ports
items.description:
The Cisco Nexus 93240YC-FX2 is a high-performance, fixed-configuration switch part of the Cisco Nexus 9300-FX2 Series, designed for modern data centers requiring high bandwidth, extensive scalability, and advanced programmability. This 1RU switch, based on Cisco Cloud Scale technology, offers 48 downlink ports supporting 1-Gbps, 10-Gbps, and 25-Gbps speeds (SFP+), and 12 uplink ports configurable as 40-Gbps or 100-Gbps (QSFP28). It provides a total switching capacity of 4.8 Tbps and a forwarding rate of up to 1.8 Bpps, ensuring efficient handling of heavy network traffic without oversubscription.

Key features include architectural flexibility with support for Cisco ACI™ and VXLAN EVPN fabrics, extensive programmability for Day Zero automation and integration with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet), and high scalability with flexible forwarding tables supporting up to 1 million shared entries. The switch incorporates intelligent buffer management to differentiate between 'mice' and 'elephant' flows during congestion, ensuring consistent low-latency performance for critical applications. It also supports RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), LAN and SAN convergence, and offers hardware and software high availability with redundant, hot-swappable power supplies and fans. The Nexus 93240YC-FX2 runs on the purpose-built Cisco NX-OS Software, known for its comprehensive innovations, and supports Cisco Tetration Analytics platform and Cisco Network Assurance Engine (NAE) for enhanced operational visibility.

items.name: Cisco SFP-10G-ER Compatible SFP+ Module - 10GBASE-ER - 10GbE Single Mode Fiber SMF Optic Transceiver
items.description:
The StarTech.com SFP-10G-ER-ST is a high-performance fiber transceiver module designed to be 100% compatible with Cisco SFP-10G-ER transceivers. It is engineered, programmed, and tested to seamlessly integrate with Cisco brand switches and routers, providing reliable 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) connectivity. This SFP+ module operates over single-mode fiber (SMF) for 10GBASE-ER compliant networks, offering an extended maximum transfer distance of up to 40 kilometers (24.8 miles). 

Key features include a 1550nm wavelength, supporting data transfer rates of 10 Gbps, and utilizing a duplex LC connector. It is hot-swappable, allowing for seamless upgrades and replacements without disrupting network operations. The module incorporates Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM) support, enabling real-time monitoring of transceiver status via most SNMP network management tools. It is compliant with SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and 10GBASE-ER/EW standards, supporting various Fibre Channel options (4x, 8x, 10x) and CPRI options 2 through 8. Additionally, this transceiver is MSA (Multi-Source Agreement) compliant, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of switches from other brands like Ubiquiti, D-Link, Netgear, Supermicro, and TP-Link that accept uncoded modules. It is RoHS-6 compliant (lead-free) and operates within a commercial temperature range of 0°C to 70°C. The robust design and comprehensive testing ensure dependable network performance for data centers, enterprise wiring closets, and service provider transport applications.

items.category: Networking Cables, Direct Attach Cables, SFP+ Cables
items.description: The Cisco SFP-H10GB-CUxM series comprises passive Direct Attach Copper (DAC) twinax cables designed for high-speed, short-distance interconnections in networking environments. These cables provide a cost-effective, low-latency, and low-power alternative to optical transceivers and fiber optic cabling for 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) and Fibre Channel applications. Compliant with SFP+ Multi-Source Agreement (MSA), SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and IEEE 802.3ae standards, these hot-pluggable cables ensure reliable performance across various compatible networking equipment. They are ideal for point-to-point connections within racks and between adjacent racks in data centers, enterprise wiring closets, and high-performance computing (HPC) environments. The passive design means no signal amplification, making them highly energy-efficient. Enhanced EMI design and AC coupled inputs/outputs contribute to robust and error-free data transmission. Available in various lengths, typically from 0.5 meters up to 5 meters for passive versions, with wire gauges adapted for optimal performance at different lengths.

items.description: The Finisar FTLX8571D3BCL is a high-performance 10 Gigabit per second (10Gb/s) SFP+ (Small Form-Factor Pluggable Plus) optical transceiver module designed for short-reach data communication applications over multimode fiber. It is fully compliant with industry standards including SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-SR/SW, as well as 10G Fibre Channel 1200-Mx-SN-I. This hot-pluggable module supports bit rates from 9.95 to 10.5 Gb/s and features an uncooled 850nm VCSEL (Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser) transmitter and a receiver with a limiting electrical interface. It utilizes a duplex LC connector for multimode fiber connections, offering a maximum link length of 300 meters over OM3 multimode fiber and up to 400 meters over OM4 multimode fiber. The FTLX8571D3BCL boasts low power dissipation of less than 1W, contributing to energy efficiency in networking environments. It operates from a single 3.3V power supply and incorporates built-in digital diagnostic functions (DDM/DOM) via a 2-wire serial interface (SFF-8472), allowing real-time monitoring of operating parameters such as transceiver temperature, laser bias current, transmitted optical power, received optical power, and supply voltage. The module is RoHS-6 compliant (lead-free), ensuring environmental responsibility. Its robust design and adherence to multiple industry standards make it a reliable and cost-effective solution for high-speed data transmission in data centers, enterprise wiring closets, and service provider transport applications.

items.name: Generic 10GBASE-SR SFP+ Transceiver Module
items.brand: Generic (Compatible with Cisco, HPE, Finisar, Juniper, etc.)
items.description: The 10GBASE-SR SFP+ Transceiver Module is a high-performance, cost-effective, and hot-pluggable optical module designed for short-range 10 Gigabit Ethernet links over multimode fiber. It is fully compliant with industry standards such as IEEE 802.3ae for 10GBASE-SR/SW, SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and SFF-8472. This transceiver features an 850nm VCSEL (Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser) transmitter and a PIN photodiode receiver, delivering reliable data transmission at speeds up to 10.3125 Gbps (10 Gigabit Ethernet) or even up to 11.3 Gbps for certain applications. It connects via a duplex LC connector and supports link lengths of up to 300 meters over OM3 multimode fiber and up to 400 meters over OM4 multimode fiber. The module also incorporates Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM/DOM) functions, allowing for real-time monitoring of operating parameters like optical output power, optical input power, laser bias current, temperature, and supply voltage. Its low power consumption (typically less than 1W) and compact SFP+ form factor make it an ideal solution for high-density data centers, enterprise wiring closets, campus networks, and service provider transport applications requiring high-speed and efficient optical connectivity. The transceiver is designed for commercial temperature ranges (0°C to 70°C) with industrial temperature options available, and is RoHS-6 compliant, ensuring environmental responsibility. This module offers flexible and customizable connectivity options for diverse network environments and is widely compatible with various networking equipment brands, supporting a 'pay-as-you-populate' model for investment protection and ease of technology migration.

items.name: Intel® Core™ i5-11400F Processor (12M Cache, up to 4.40 GHz)
items.description:
The Intel Core i5-11400F is a powerful 11th Generation desktop processor, part of the Rocket Lake-S architecture, designed to deliver excellent performance for gaming, productivity, and multitasking. Launched in March 2021, this processor features 6 cores and 12 threads, benefiting from Intel Hyper-Threading Technology to double the effective core count. It operates with a base clock frequency of 2.60 GHz and can dynamically boost up to an impressive 4.40 GHz using Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0. [1, 3] 

Equipped with 12 MB of Intel® Smart Cache (L3 Cache), the i5-11400F ensures quick access to data, enhancing overall system responsiveness. It's built on a 14 nm lithography process and has a Thermal Design Power (TDP) of 65 W, making it an efficient choice for modern PC builds. [1, 3] Notably, the 'F' in its nomenclature indicates that this processor does not include integrated graphics, requiring a separate dedicated graphics card for display output. [2] 

Memory support includes DDR4-3200 with a dual-channel interface, allowing for a maximum memory size of 128 GB and a peak memory bandwidth of 50 GB/s. For system connectivity, the Core i5-11400F utilizes a PCI-Express Gen 4 interface, providing 20 lanes for high-speed communication with the latest discrete graphics cards and other PCIe devices. [1, 3] Advanced technologies like Intel® Optane™ Memory support, Intel® Deep Learning Boost, and a comprehensive set of instruction set extensions including SSE4.1, SSE4.2, AVX2, and AVX-512 enhance its capabilities for a wide range of applications. Hardware virtualization (Intel VT-x, VT-d) is also fully supported, improving virtual machine performance and allowing for IOMMU virtualization (PCI passthrough). [1, 3]

items.name: Micron MT25QU02GCBB8E12-0SIT 2Gbit (256MB) Serial NOR Flash Memory, SPI, 1.8V, TBGA-24
items.description: The Micron MT25QU02GCBB8E12-0SIT is a high-performance 2Gbit (256MB) Serial NOR Flash memory device designed for demanding applications requiring reliable code storage and rapid data access. It features a high-speed SPI-compatible bus interface, supporting both single and double transfer rates (STR/DTR) with extended, dual, and quad I/O protocols. This enables increased throughput up to 90MB/s and a maximum clock frequency of 166MHz. The device supports Execute-in-Place (XIP) functionality, allowing the CPU to directly execute code from flash, which is crucial for fast boot times in embedded systems. Advanced write protection mechanisms and extended address access ensure data integrity and flexibility. It operates on a low 1.7V to 2.0V supply voltage, with a nominal 1.8V, and boasts a wide operating temperature range from -40°C to +85°C. Housed in a compact 24-ball T-PBGA (6x8) package, it is suitable for surface mount assembly. Key reliability features include a minimum of 100,000 ERASE cycles per sector and data retention of 20 years (typical). It also includes security features like volatile and non-volatile locking and software write protection for each 64KB sector, along with password protection. The device is RoHS3 compliant, making it suitable for modern electronic designs.
items.overview: The Micron MT25QU02GCBB8E12-0SIT is a highly versatile and robust 2Gbit Serial NOR Flash memory, part of the MT25Q series, offering advanced features for modern embedded systems. It excels in applications requiring reliable code storage (boot, application, OS, and execute-in-place [XIP] code) and frequently changing small data storage. Its twin-quad serial NOR flash architecture combines two quad I/O devices into a single package, creating an 8-bit bidirectional I/O structure that, coupled with a 166MHz operating frequency, achieves a maximum bandwidth rate of 166MB/s. This makes it an ideal solution for automotive systems, industrial automation, networking devices, and solid-state drives (SSDs) where low power consumption, high-speed performance, and critical data protection are paramount. The device's industry-standard packaging, pinouts, and command sets ensure easy integration and compatibility with existing and future designs, saving valuable development time.

items.name: SFP-10GLR-31 10GBASE-LR SFP+ 1310nm 10km DOM LC SMF Transceiver Module
items.description: The SFP-10GLR-31 is a high-performance Small Form-Factor Pluggable Plus (SFP+) optical transceiver module designed for 10 Gigabit Ethernet applications. It operates at a wavelength of 1310nm and can transmit data over single-mode fiber (SMF) for distances up to 10 kilometers. This module supports Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM), providing real-time diagnostic information on parameters such as temperature, voltage, transmitted/received optical power. It adheres to IEEE 802.3ae, SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and SFP+ MSA standards, ensuring broad compatibility with various networking hardware devices from major vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Brocade, HP, Dell, and Arista. The SFP-10GLR-31 features low power consumption (typically less than 1W), high reliability, and robust performance, making it an ideal solution for data centers, enterprise wiring closets, service provider transport applications, and Radio & Baseband Units (RRU/BBU). It boasts a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of over 1,000,000 hours and operates within a commercial temperature range of 0 to 70°C. Its hot-pluggable design and built-in Semtech Chip contribute to its high-performance and energy-efficient operation. Each module is rigorously tested for compatibility and performance to ensure flawless integration and operation in diverse network environments.

items.name: SFP-10GM-T-30 10GBASE-T Copper SFP+ Transceiver Module, 30m, RJ-45
items.description: The FS SFP-10GM-T-30 copper transceiver module is a high-performance, cost-effective integrated duplex data link designed for bi-directional communication over copper cable. It is specifically engineered for high-speed communication links that require 10 Gigabit Ethernet over Cat6a/7 cable with a reach of up to 30 meters. This module features multi-rate auto-negotiation capability, supporting speed adaptation across 10M/100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G operational modes, with the final link speed determined by the peer device's capability. It is compliant with IEEE 802.3-2012, IEEE 802.3ab, and IEEE 802.3az standards for Gigabit Ethernet and 10GBASE-T. The SFP-10GM-T-30 provides standard serial ID information compliant with SFP+ MSA (SFF-8431, SFF-8432, and SFF-8472), accessible via the 2-wire serial CMOS EEPROM protocol. It operates on a single +3.3V power supply and is hot-pluggable, allowing for easy field replacement or upgrades. The module features a compact RJ-45 connector assembly and a fully metallic enclosure for low EMI emissions and excellent ESD protection. It also supports Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) for critical operating parameters. This transceiver does not support backward compatibility with 1G SFP ports; while physically insertable, link establishment will fail due to incompatible electrical signaling.

The SFP10GLRST is built for IT professionals, ensuring it meets or exceeds OEM specifications and Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) industry standards, and is also compatible with a wide range of MSA compliant switches from brands like Ubiquiti, D-Link, Netgear, Supermicro, and TP-Link.

items.overview:
A powerhouse in the realm of data storage, the WD Red Pro 3.5" SATA III Internal NAS Hard Drive is meticulously engineered to meet the high-performance and reliability demands of commercial and enterprise NAS environments. These enterprise-class hard drives are specifically designed to handle high-intensity workloads, making them ideal for 24x7 multi-user operations. The WD Red Pro drives excel in delivering the performance, scalability, and dependability that businesses require for storing, sharing, and collaborating on vast amounts of data within multi-bay RAID-optimized NAS systems. At the heart of this drive's optimization is Western Digital's exclusive NASware technology, which fine-tunes drive parameters to align with NAS system workloads, thereby enhancing both performance and reliability.

One of the standout features of the WD Red Pro is its protection against excessive vibration. Equipped with Rotation Vibration (RV) sensors, these drives can anticipate and counteract disturbances caused by increased vibration, dispersing it across the drive chassis to maintain performance and safeguard the drives. Designed for continuous operation, WD Red Pro hard drives are built to endure the rigorous demands of high-intensity, always-on NAS environments, thereby increasing system durability. They also incorporate a multi-axis shock sensor to detect subtle shock events, automatically compensating with dynamic fly height technology to further protect the drives within NAS enclosures.

Compatibility is a key consideration, and Western Digital ensures that WD Red Pro drives are tested extensively with a wide range of NAS system vendors to guarantee dependable compatibility with most NAS enclosures. These drives are engineered with industry-leading technology, featuring Western Digital's proprietary OptiNAND technology. This innovation leverages integrated iNAND embedded flash to perform essential housekeeping functions, freeing up more capacity and enhancing overall drive performance. When choosing a hard drive for your NAS, it's crucial to opt for one that is purpose-built for RAID-optimized systems. Unlike standard desktop drives, WD Red Pro hard drives are specifically designed and tested for NAS environments, incorporating NASware technology to fine-tune drive parameters for optimal performance.

They are built to withstand the demands of an always-on NAS environment, offering RAID error recovery control to reduce failures in multi-bay systems. Additionally, they provide superior noise and vibration protection, thanks to their RV sensors, which are essential in multi-drive NAS setups. In summary, the WD Red Pro 3.5" SATA III Internal NAS Hard Drive stands out as a reliable and high-performing solution for businesses seeking to optimize their NAS systems for maximum efficiency and data protection.
